subject: general
question: What was the theme of Expo 2025 in Osaka, Japan?

options.text: Designing Future Society for Our Lives
Feeding the Planet, Energy for Life

solution:
The correct answer is __**Designing Future Society for Our Lives**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The theme for Expo 2025 in Osaka, Japan, is **"Designing Future Society for Our Lives"**, emphasizing innovative solutions for global challenges.
 
• Expo 2025 will aim to explore sustainable development goals (SDGs) and address pressing global issues such as health, environment, and technology.
 
• It will be held on **Yumeshima Island, Osaka**, from **April 13 to October 13, 2025**.
 
• The event is expected to attract over **28 million visitors** from around the world, fostering cultural and technological exchange.
 
• The Expo is being organized by the Bureau International des Expositions (BIE), the intergovernmental organization responsible for overseeing world exhibitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Expos:**

 
 
• World Expos, also known as World Fairs, are large international exhibitions showcasing achievements in science, technology, art, and culture.
 
• The first World Expo was held in **London in 1851**, called "The Great Exhibition."
 
• They are organized by the Bureau International des Expositions (BIE) and occur every five years.
 
 
 
• **Osaka's Role in Expo History:**
 
 
• Osaka previously hosted the **Expo 1970**, which was the first World Expo held in Japan.
 
• The theme of Expo 1970 was **"Progress and Harmony for Mankind."**
 
• It attracted 64 million visitors, making it one of the most successful Expos in history.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• Expo 2025 aligns with the United Nations' **17 Sustainable Development Goals**, promoting global collaboration for a better future.
 
• Key focus areas include climate action, health and well-being, and technological advancements.
 
 
 
• **Yumeshima Island:**
 
 
• Yumeshima is a man-made island in Osaka Bay, chosen as the venue for Expo 2025.
 
• It is being developed as a hub for innovation, sustainability, and tourism.
 
• The island will also host integrated resort facilities, including casinos, after the Expo.
